verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline and subhead together, but the CTA has shrunk to a tiny pill with text too small to read. It sits off on its own near the bottom edge, about 300px below the copy, so the main action is buried. B's CTA is larger and easier to read, but the subhead is now tiny fine print floating halfway between the headline and the button. The three elements are spread out with uneven gaps and big dead areas, so the group falls apart. B is still the less broken of the two.
